work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult CXXXVIII grants the dignitaries and canons of the Magliano cathedral the cappa magna; decree, non obstantibus and dating clause survive. Its provenance note1 is LF28641. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF28549–28549; the source dating clause at LF28635–28638 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima octava februar. millesimo Octingentesimo quadragesimo secundo, pontifi- catus Nostri anno decimo secundo, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
